scope: Follow-up to adaptive-layout-qa.json: keyboard, foldable safety, accessibility and tablet detail panes

implementation.keyboard: Shared focused-field visibility supplements native insets; duplicate avoidance removed from auth and transaction details; navigation hides while a native keyboard is shown.
implementation.foldables: Android WindowManager 1.5.1 reports separating/occluding hinges. A stable route tree occupies the larger unobstructed pane, left/top on ties. Native modal windows use the same policy. This is safe single-pane support, not dual-screen spanning.
implementation.accessibility: Reduced motion for route/modal transitions, iOS increased-contrast colors, browser contrast preferences and keyboard focus outlines, decorative icon suppression and button semantics.
implementation.tablet: Transactions preview beside list, investment institution assets beside accounts, chat history beside Ask Clover. Width and font scale govern split layouts; compact layouts preserve state.
implementation.browser: Visual-viewport focus correction for software keyboards/zoom; existing upload drop zones and file pickers retained. Native file drag-and-drop is not implemented.

browser.renderer: Expo RN Web local sample preview in Chromium

interactions: Account entry draft preserved after 1366 to 540 width resize
Ask Clover draft preserved after 1366 to 390 width resize
Tab focuses Institution with a 3px visible outline
Transaction selection displays details beside the list
Fictional investment institution selection shows assets and survives collapse to 540px
verification.simulator: iPad Pro 11-inch M5 / iOS 26.5 Safari rendered the local Transactions preview at 834 logical pixels. This is WebKit rendering verification, not native-app or physical-device certification.
verification.androidNative: clover-window:compileDebugKotlin passed, including autolinking and WindowManager dependency resolution
verification.geometry: 12 windows x 5 text scales plus separating/flat/stale hinges, floating and docked keyboard overlap, resized Android viewport and readable detail-pane thresholds
verification.uploadRegression: Existing native upload tests passed: compressed camera bytes, stale size metadata, encrypted retention, corruption and real photo/document limits
verification.releaseGate: npm run qa:prepush is enforced by the staging pre-push hook; check the commit CI for the release-gate outcome
verification.chatComposer: Component regression passed for after-reply composer: phone/tablet and keyboard shown/hidden; reserves visible dock and safe area, with one keyboard inset owner.

physicalDeviceChecksPending: iPad docked, floating and split keyboard typing through every add/edit form
Android tablet/foldable hardware keyboard, live hinge changes and OEM window resizing
VoiceOver and TalkBack reading/focus order; large text on physical devices
Real camera/file-provider permissions and upload while backgrounded
Apple/Google login and test purchases after resize/background/resume
Startup and scrolling performance on a lower-memory physical device
release: Staging only. Native changes require future binaries. No production deployment or store submission requested.
